name: Customer credit approval
description: New orders above €20k require documented credit review and approval before shipment.

name: Invoice-to-shipping match
description: Billing system blocks invoices without a matching shipping record (automated three-way check).
risk_desc: Invoices issued for goods not shipped — revenue overstated (occurrence).

name: Monthly revenue analytics review
description: Controller reviews monthly revenue vs budget/prior year, investigates variances > 10%.

name: Price master change approval
description: Changes to the price master require CFO approval
assertions: Unauthorized price changes distort revenue accuracy.

name: Monthly bank reconciliation
description: Bank account 512100 reconciled to the GL within 10 days of month end
assertions: Cash misstatements or unrecorded transactions not detected.

name: Payment dual authorization
description: Outgoing payments above €10k require two authorized signatories in the banking portal.

name: Quarterly user access review
description: ERP user access rights reviewed quarterly
assertions: Inappropriate access undermines automated controls and segregation of duties.
